question: At the time of "Greed of a Pig", Priscilla said "If you lick my foot, it's not impossible that I'll help you." and Subaru tried to lick it, but if Subaru got angry and said "Quit messing around, damnit!", how would it have turned out? Would she have lent a hand?
answer: It probably would have turned out better than when he tried to lick it, but really, with Subaru in such a tunnel-vision state, it was probably no good no matter what he said. That was a route where he'd picked the wrong button from the start, and it wasn't going to work no matter what he did.
